name: graph_from_blank_forward
description: GL-1d with RS-2: the same as graph_from_blank with forward_opaque_v1, the palette default and the contract the user first tried from Blank. Blank routes materials to deferred; with no deferred pass in the pipeline Studio sends material_route_default forward with the edit (RS-2), the engine commits it and asks for a restart, and after the restart the pass draws with its draw loop. GL-1e: a Cube added, the material pass's colour output (GL-1f) is dragged onto present's + input in the Graph; Studio sends edit_preset_pass on present (as the Pass Editor saves it), the line is drawn solid, and the viewport shows what the pass drew instead of the gradient (with the engine's RS-3, which puts the graph's pass before present). UX-2: a fullscreen pass from the palette, and its image's format picked in the image's fields (R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT, UX-6a's default, to R8G8B8A8_UNORM) from the engine's list, not typed; the engine commits it.
